items.title: A restart mid-minute resets the cap
items.why: The count lives in process memory, so a deploy or crash in the middle of the 60 s window lets the same address get 3 more mails.
items.comment: Scenario: 3 resets for `user@acme.test`, then the API restarts at 30 s, then 3 more resets → 6 mails in 60 s, not 3. Could the counter live in the shared store (e.g. Redis `INCR` with a 60 s TTL) before this is turned on?

change.body: count = store.incr(`reset:${email}`, ttl=60s)  # survives restarts and is shared by every instance

coverage.checked: restart, case of the address, clock jump
